$comment: Identifier values that are KNOWN SYNTHETIC and may appear in code, tests, fixtures and docs. The agent harness (scripts/harness/pre-tool-guard.ts) and phi-scan refuse any other SSN- or MBI-shaped value. SSNs with area 000, 666 or 900-999 are never issued and are always allowed without listing. Adding a value here is a human decision: .claude/settings.json makes edits to compliance/** ask for approval. Seeded 2026-10-27 from the values already committed in the repo (grandfathered) — Reviewed 2026-10-28 (see `reviewed`): `arch:compliance` recomputes the fingerprint over ssn+mbi and fails when the lists change without a new review, so adding a value is always a visible, deliberate edit.

reviewed.confirmed: none of these is a real person's identifier
